column1: # Golden vectors for the zoom / FORMAT maths, shared by both shells.
# Kotlin re-implements them by hand in `Apps/Android/.../session`. Nothing links
# the two, so they drift silently. This file is the one thing both test suites
# the repo root, parse it, and assert their own core produces every expected
# value. A row that fails on one side and passes on the other IS the drift.
# Regenerate only from the Swift core, and only when the behaviour change is
# intended -- a vector edited to match a Kotlin bug defeats the whole file.
# Tab-separated: kind, inputs..., expected. `-` is nil/absent. Numbers are
# compared with a 1e-4 tolerance, not as text.
#   lensPosition     factor            -> lens             the SET unit
#   matches          live target       -> true|false       pin confirmation
#   nextJump         factor stops      -> factor           chip cycle up
#   previousJump     factor stops      -> factor           chip cycle down
#   stopWithinCycle  stop stops        -> factor           stop kept in range
#   activeZoomStops  name family res mode -> stops
#   ceilingNote      size held stops   -> text             FORMAT-drop warning
